FIELD MANUAL

A little strategy goes a long way.

You command the teal outposts. The red bot wants the same territory.

  1. Select your outpost, then click a target to deploy troops.
  2. Choose 25–100% of its garrison. Fleets reinforce friendly outposts or fight defenders.
  3. Spend troops on upgrades to increase production.
  4. Eliminate all enemy outposts and fleets. At 5 minutes, the larger army and territory wins.

Keyboard: Tab focuses the map, arrow keys cycle outposts, Enter selects or attacks, Escape clears selection, U upgrades, Space pauses.
